scope: Standing Al-Hakim Mosque in Historic Cairo after the 2023 restoration, including its monumental gateway, unequal minarets, arcaded open courtyard and fountain, and eastern prayer range.

originalReview.notes: Shows both standing minaret tops in opposite orientations: rounded longitudinal ribs, carved and bracketed collars, arched openings and different square and octagonal transition courses.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s sole candidate was examined for provenance first. No authoritative creator CC0 release could be traced. The Met’s native 1842–1843 public-domain daguerreotype shows both minarets and provides the distinguishing exterior reference.
